overview.text: IIIT-Delhi, a State University of Govt. of NCT of Delhi, invites sealed bids from IT firms to run the Pan-India computer-based MCQ Post Graduate Computer Science & Engineering Admission Test (PGCAT-IIITD). The test is scheduled for Sunday, May 3rd 2026 in 8 cities for approx 2000 candidates in one shift. Selection is by QCBS. Contract duration is not specified in the document.

summary.issuing_organization: Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIIT-Delhi), a State University of Govt. of NCT of Delhi; Registrar, Okhla Phase-III, New Delhi-110020; Tender ID IIIT-D/Acad./Test/001/2026-27; Nodal officer Sanjana Soni, admin-mtech@iiitd.ac.in

scope.text: Provide infrastructure (human resources and machines) for the PGCAT-IIITD computer-based MCQ test for M.Tech. CSE, CSE-Research and PhD CSE on Sunday, May 3rd 2026; one shift, approx 2000 candidates in total; test duration 02 hours.

Run the exam in 8 cities: Lucknow, Delhi, Ahmedabad, Bangalore, Bhopal, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata. One centre per city; an extra centre only if registered candidates exceed 200, with justification and prior approval.

Centre operations: hall ticket and Govt. photo ID checks, signature and attendance sheets, digital photo and bio-metric fingerprint capture, invigilation, stationery, and terminal allotment with user ID and password.
Develop, host and manage the exam web pages; arrange connectivity and security software; conduct the test and authenticate and evaluate candidate responses.
Set up a centralized control room at IIIT Delhi on exam day with live centre-wise dashboards: students logged in, actively taking the exam, and completed.
Support admit card generation and notify applicants by Email and SMS, for M.Tech. and PhD separately, within two days of receiving applicant data from IIIT-Delhi.
Result module: link results to the main database, let candidates see marks with their credentials, share raw data on exam day and the final result a day later.
Hand over all data after the exam and result declaration, and retain it for six months from the date of result declaration.

key_requirements.text: Exam platform must be fully functional at least one month before the exam and be independently tested and approved by IIITD experts.
A dry run of the platform at IIIT Delhi is mandatory at least one day before the exam.

Each centre must have at least 2 experienced technical persons from the agency managing the LAN and 1 experienced centre head; the centre head and at least one technical person per LAN must be the bidder's own staff on main exam and mock run days.
Question paper arrives one/two day(s) before the exam and must be secured with two-key authentication; one key stays with IIIT-Delhi and is disclosed on exam day only.
Candidate systems must have a 4 core processor with minimum 2.0 Ghz or above, RAM 4 GB or above, and Windows operating system.

Minimum staff per centre of capacity 100 + 20 buffer, scaled proportionately: Test Centre Administrator 1; IT Manager 1 per 100 candidates; IT Support Staff 2, Support Staff 2, Security Guard 2 and Peons 2 per 100 candidates; Invigilators 2 per 25 systems or per lab.
Centres are preferably within approximately 10 kilometers of the city's main railway station or airport, and must have washrooms for male and female candidates and safe drinking water.
Uninterrupted power supply (UPS), generator availability and sufficient air-conditioning in testing labs must be ensured at every centre.
Appoint a dedicated single point of contact with at least three support staff for both mock day and main day; a self-certified document confirming this must be enclosed.

System must be tested for performance, security, usability, high availability, business continuity and disaster recovery, with results available for each major release; applicant database must not be disclosed to any third party.

eligibility.text: Joint ventures or consortiums are NOT allowed; bidder must bid on its own strength and meet all criteria, with a self-declaration on letterhead.
Bidder must be registered in India and operating in India for a minimum of 5 years; must give registration number with valid GST and PAN, as a self-certified document.
Average annual turnover must be Rs. 10 Lakhs in the last three financial years, certified by a Chartered Accountant from audited balance sheet extracts and Profit & Loss account.
ISO 9001-2012 or better certificate; copy must be submitted.

Must have successfully executed similar project(s) on all India basis in last 3 financial years, meaning conduct and processing of CBT online examination; proof of work, contract or satisfactory client report as per Annexure 5.
Must hold GST registration and Income Tax/PAN number, with copies of registration certificates.
Must not have been blacklisted by any Govt. agency; self-declaration on stamp paper in the format of Annexure 2.
Must have a full-fledged service and support centre at Delhi/NCR, with office details and the responsible officer, and a self-declaration on letterhead.

important_dates.text: Pre-bid meeting and query deadline are not given; clarifications go to the nodal officer.
Last date for bid submission: 9th March 2026 up to 12:00 Noon.
Technical bids opened on 10th March 2026 at 3.00 P.M.
Financial bid opening: to be communicated later.
Financial bid validity: not less than 60 days from the date of opening of bid.
Annexure 3 states quoted rates remain valid for 60 days from 23rd February 2026.
Last date of online application (by IIIT-Delhi): Monday, April 13, 2026.
PGCAT-IIITD exam and sharing of raw result data (bidder): Sunday, May 3, 2026.
Sharing of final result (bidder): Monday, May 4, 2026.

commercial_requirements.text: EMD of Rs.50,000/- by demand draft in favour of "IIIT-Delhi Collections" payable at New Delhi; no interest paid; exempt for MSMEs/NSIC registered suppliers.
Tender document can be downloaded; a copy from the Institute needs a non-refundable fee of Rs.1,000/-+18% GST extra i.e. (Rs. 1,180/-); exempt for MSMEs/NSIC registered suppliers.

Performance bank guarantee of 5% of PO value within 15 days of the PO date, failing which the bidder is notified as blacklisted; valid 60 days beyond contract cessation; no interest; forfeited on termination for non-performance.
Prices in INR only, all-inclusive of taxes, charges and installation at IIIT-Delhi; any discount must be shown only on the proforma discount line.
Payment terms and milestones are not detailed; only payment at the quoted rates per the bid document terms is stated.
SLA breach fine: Rs. 5000/- per day for the first seven days and Rs. 8,000/- per day from the 8th day onwards.
Delay compensation at 1% per week, subject to a maximum of 10 % of the contract amount.
Warranty period is not stated; the PBG validity is described as co-terminus with the warranty period.

project_duration.text: Contract duration is not stated; the document refers only to the stipulated period of the contract.
Completion period is reckoned within one week of issue of the work order.
Platform must be available and independently tested at least one month before the exam; dry run at least one day before.
Admit cards and notifications within two days of receiving applicant data from IIIT-Delhi.
Data retention for six months from the date of result declaration.

important_conditions.text: Evaluation: QCBS; the bidder with the highest composite score is selected, with weightage of 70% technical and 30% financial.

Evaluation: technical points table totals 60 Points: exam plan 10, platform demonstration 10, in-person presentation at IIIT-Delhi campus 10, experience 30 (5 Years = 10; 5-8 years = 20; 8 years & more = 30).
Evaluation: financial bids are opened only for bidders who qualify in technical evaluation; IIITD may negotiate with the selected bidder.
Submission: two-bid system; technical and financial bids sealed separately and enclosed in a sealed envelope addressed to Registrar IIIT-Delhi.
Submission: technical bid must contain the EMD and complete technical details; technical bids without EMD will be summarily rejected.

Submission: physical deposit in the Tender Box in Store & Purchase department, Room no. A 108, First Floor, Old Academic Block; late bids not accepted and the Institute is not responsible for postal/courier delay.
Submission: financial bid on Annexure 3 proforma in INR only; Annexure 1 vendor information must accompany the financial bid.
Submission: Annexure 2 blacklisting undertaking and Annexure 5 proof of similar projects must be provided.
Risk: weights conflict; Technical Proposal (70%) and Financial Proposal (30%), versus Technical Evaluation - Total 60 Points with no financial scoring points given.
Risk: bid validity conflict; 60 days from opening of bid, versus rates valid 60 days from 23rd February 2026, which is before the 9th March 2026 submission deadline.
Risk: PBG timing conflict; 15 days from the date of award of the work, versus 15 days from the date of PO, with blacklisting on failure.
Risk: if system failure causes the exam to fail, the whole exam is conducted again with the cost of the second examination borne by the bidder.
Risk: Annexure 5, the proof format cited for the similar-project eligibility criterion, has only its heading on its page; no format is provided.
Risk: blacklisting undertaking conflict; eligibility asks for stamp paper, but Annexure 2 says company letterhead.
